subject.title: [Bug]: sessions_yield subagent wake can compact parent branch at low context usage

question: Should this issue require both the runtime overflow-decision fix and persisted compaction trigger metadata before it can close?
rationale: The premature-compaction bug is runtime correctness, but adding a typed compaction trigger changes persisted transcript diagnostics and should be a maintainer-owned schema/product boundary choice.

options.title: Fix Runtime And Trigger Metadata
options.body: Keep this issue open until successful-turn overflow uses trustworthy context snapshots or sane usage guards and compaction entries carry a typed cause such as overflow, threshold, manual, or sessions-yield wake.

options.title: Split Trigger Metadata
options.body: Use this issue only for the premature compaction fix and move persisted compaction cause metadata to a narrower diagnostics follow-up.

options.title: Wait For Live Repro
options.body: Defer implementation until QA can reproduce the yielded-parent/subagent wake path on current main with complete runtime logs.

recommendation.title: Fix Runtime And Trigger Metadata
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open until successful-turn overflow uses trustworthy context snapshots or sane usage guards and compaction entries carry a typed cause such as overflow, threshold, manual, or sessions-yield wake.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining choice is mostly compaction-policy and context-engine diagnostics, and Josh Lehman has the strongest recent adjacent history there.
